title: Internal energy decreases despite heating
statement:
A sample absorbs 160 J of heat and increases its volume while doing 225 J of work. What is its internal-energy change?

[_]{a}

explanations: Heat enters and the larger work transfer leaves.
Work by the sample was assigned a positive sign.
Heat entering was assigned a negative sign.

hints: Identify the direction of each transfer.
Work by the sample is negative.
